what_this_is: Web-verified public bank sandbox targets for the TLS-handshake -> CycloneDX NBOM probe (scripts/tls_cbom_probe.py --bank-sandboxes). Each entry names the provider, its developer portal, the TLS probe target, what authentication the SANDBOX needs for API CALLS (the TLS handshake itself needs no key), and exactly what was verified from which source.
what_this_is_not: Not evidence of coverage. The build sandbox's egress is restricted to github/npm/pypi (verified empirically 2026-10-14: ALL targets below are unreachable from it). Run this pack from a network with open egress. A provider's TLS handshake proves the transport layer only; API-level integration still needs the portal registration and keys noted per entry.
